experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/comet.ts

Comet builder — a SF_KINDS.COMET body is a dark
Source src/experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/comet.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

TAIL_W

Tail gradient canvas — long narrow streak, alpha fades along +x.

tailFor

Paints the shared tail sprite texture: a horizontal gradient that is brightest at the left edge (the end rooted at the nucleus) and fades smoothly to nothing on the right (the tip dissolving into space), with a vertical cosine falloff so the streak is a soft spindle, not a hard-edged ribbon. White-only — the SpriteMaterial color supplies the ion/dust tint so one texture serves both tails.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @returns A CanvasTexture, or undefined without a 2d context.

makeComet

Builds the comet composite: an irregular, nearly-black nucleus (the real Halley albedo is ~0.04 — one of the darkest known bodies), a soft additive coma sprite hugging it, and the ion + dust tail sprites. The nucleus mesh becomes the node's mesh/spinner so it tumbles normally; coma rides inside it (a symmetric billboard is indifferent to spin); the tails mount on center where local +x is permanently anti-sunward.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog entry — radius sizes the nucleus; ecc/orbit
  • @param texMap Loaded texture map (a comet with a real nucleus map
  • @param glowTex Shared radial-glow texture for the coma sprite.
  • @returns { mesh, coma, ion, dust } — the pickable nucleus group

tailSprite

One tail sprite — camera-facing, so the streak reads from every angle. Its center sits at len/2 along +x so the texture's bright root edge lands on the nucleus and the fade runs anti-sunward. tilt swings the sprite's origin off the ecliptic plane so the dust fan visibly lags the ion streak.
